summary: Added combined arm to agent-memory bench harness. run_probe_combined() in probe_runner.py retrieves from both the raw-chunk workspace and the atomic-fact distill workspace independently, filters stubs from each pool, merges by key (fact_hits take precedence on collision), re-ranks by score descending, and answers from the merged top-k context. Wired in run.py: added "combined" to valid_arms, imported run_probe_combined, updated _run_conv to call it per-probe using both workspace and distill_workspace, and added auto-enable logic so passing --arms combined automatically activates distill ingest if not already present. Distiller initialization condition updated to trigger on "combined" as well as "distill". Committed as bb62c70 on orch/attempt/bench-combined-arm.
